title: Part 1 final answer
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct expression for the pressure at point B: N' = m(v₀²/r) + mg - kQq/r².

title: Part 2 final answer
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct expression for the minimum speed at point A: v = √(kQq/(mr) + gr).

title: Force balance at B
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Newton's second law at point B, summing all radial forces (normal, electric, gravitational) to equal the centripetal force.

title: Force balance at A
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Newton's second law at point A, recognizing that the normal force is zero for minimum speed and summing electric and gravitational forces toward the center.

title: Newton's third law
description: Important Criteria: For part (1), the student must explicitly state or apply that the pressure on the track equals the normal force exerted by the track on the ball.

title: Direction of forces
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns the direction of the electric force (attraction toward center) or gravitational force at points A and B.

title: Minimum speed condition
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student fails to set the normal force to zero when solving for the minimum speed at point A.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional Criteria: The student shows clear algebraic steps in solving for the normal force and minimum speed expressions.
